sources.note: Wiener Linien Tap+Ride pilot uses open-loop cards/Apple Express Mode; WienMobil keeps tickets in-app, no native Apple Wallet pass.
City of Vienna press release: the Tap+Ride pilot is open-loop payment at selected stations, not a native Wallet ticket.
WienMobil App Store listing (AT): tickets stored in-app; no Apple Wallet pass export option listed.
Futurezone Oct 2026: Wiener Linien confirms they want to offer Wallet integration in the future but no timeline set; nativePkpass still none.
